purpose: First-party cadastral-source discovery and bounded anonymous service review for Tripoli, Lebanon.
assessment: A local Tripoli registry and survey-office custodian is evidenced by the official Directorate General of Land Registry and Cadastre. Its public title-register page is a lookup workflow requiring parcel identifiers, not an anonymous geometry service. An official Ministry of Public Health ArcGIS endpoint was inspected and queried, but its Cadaster layer is cadastral-zone polygons with zone names/codes, not individual parcel polygons. No safe parcel sample is retained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true: the official LRC publishes Tripoli registry/survey-office organizational evidence and cadastral-map procedures. This is local custodian evidence, not source integration or adapter qualification.
